link.title: Getting Started With Bitbybit Monaco Editor For TypeScript
link.description: The Monaco editor gives you the full Bitbybit API in TypeScript, with the same IntelliSense, type checking and inline documentation you would get in VS Code. If you already write code, this is the fastest and least constrained way to use the platform: the whole language is available, so loops, functions, classes and your own abstractions all work normally. These pages cover the editor, a first 3D Hello World, an introduction to TypeScript for people coming from the visual editors, and building a parametric cube in code.
